window_selection: minimum landmark/object distance with contiguous 3 s tracking
world_transform: T_world_wrist = T_world_device @ T_device_wrist; Z-up; meters; xyzw
limitations: Recorded MANO fits and authored object initial pose; no tracked object trajectory or success labels. Fixed supplied hand morphology, not subject-specific MANO shape fitting.

wrist_normalization.source: Three unlimited slides plus an unlimited ball joint
wrist_normalization.import: One equivalent free joint to avoid current importer solreflimit DOF-index failure
wrist_normalization.drive: Explicit world-space PD wrench because MuJoCo free joints cannot have position actuators; translational gains tunable, rotational kp=30 N m/rad and kd=2 N m s/rad; force cap100 N and torque cap10 N m.

scene_setup: Dynamic free MANO wrist, ball-joint fingers, scanned convex object collision, source mass/friction, inferred planar support, no hand self-collision or hand/plane contact. Object is passive.
